name: Ninja Van Singapore (Ninja Logistics Pte. Ltd.)

scam_info.sample: We have been alerted to two fake e-commerce sites claiming to be associated with Ninja Van (ninjavanmall.com and ninjavanshopping.com)
scam_info.notes: 'Parcel Delivery Scams Advisory' (SG): 'Latest scam updates' (email phishing as 'Ninja Van SG') + 3 previous updates (SMS phishing, fraudulent WhatsApp surveys, fake Ninja Van mall sites). Undated. Fake domains (text only, never visited): ninjavanmall.com, ninjavanshopping.com. Official channels stated: NinjaChat (Facebook Messenger / Telegram bot / Viber), verified social media and WhatsApp accounts (no number given), emails ending @ninjavan.co; COD PayNow payee 'Ninja Logistics Pte. Ltd.' UEN201412014EB2B (official). Same content also at /en-sg/support/recipient-support/parcel-scams-advisory (both in sitemap; no lastmod).

notes: SG pages under ninjavan.co/en-sg. official_domains: ninjavan.co is (b) serving domain and (a) official email domain ('email addresses that end with ninjavan.co'). Hosts dashboard./delivery./walrus.ninjavan.co seen in homepage links. NinjaChat channels (Telegram bot, Messenger, Viber) are the official notification channels; t.me/NinjaVanBot and messenger.com/t/957138134486129 linked from footer. ninjaxpress.co (Indonesia sister brand) appears in the same sitemap but is not SG; not added. SMS: Ninja Van tells users to use NinjaChat instead of SMS (no SG sender ID published). Shopee's delivery-impersonation advisory also names NinjaVan.
